baseline_gaps.baseline: FPU_CVT_W_S uses nearbyintf then casts; source does not implement Sony truncation/saturation contract
baseline_gaps.evidence: manual printed p.356; fractional inputs differ under FE_TONEAREST; out-of-range conversion has no explicit saturation in baseline
manual signed-zero table requires MIN(+0,-0)=-0 and MAX(-0,+0)=+0; baseline first-operand tie behavior differs

baseline_gaps.baseline: FPU_SQRT_S delegates to sqrtf; translator emits no FCR31 updates
baseline_gaps.evidence: manual printed p.376 requires SQRT(ABS(x)) for negative x, I/SI set, D cause clear

baseline_gaps.baseline: host float operators; DIV.S special-cases denominator == 0 to infinity and only ORs one flag bit
baseline_gaps.evidence: manual requires signed finite maximum, specific cause/sticky flags, exponent overflow saturation and underflow flush; custom rounding is also specified

result.stdout: PASS: manual-derived bounded reference cases and baseline negative controls

prototype_probe.interpretation: Manual-derived reference cases pass and baseline expression negative controls demonstrate selected discrepancies. Candidate code is illustrative and tightly bounded; no general FPU replacement is proposed.

limitations: No silicon or emulator oracle was used.
Host sqrt/arithmetic is not certified bit-identical to the EE's custom rounding implementation.
NaN, infinity, denormal, broad overflow/underflow, and complete FCR31 semantics are out of scope.
MIN/MAX prototype checks finite value results and signed-zero result bits only; it does not model O/U flag clearing.
SQRT prototype checks exact roots and selected FCR cause/sticky bits only; arbitrary positive-root rounding is not certified.
DIV.S remains unmodeled because its special cases, signs, saturation, and flags require a source-backed result model.

comparator_caveat: PCSX2 is treated as an independent software comparator, not a hardware oracle. Manual statements anchor the bounded semantics; overall EE bit-exactness is unproved.

changes: guarded CVT.W.S toward-zero conversion and exponent saturation
MIN.S/MAX.S signed-zero selection and O/U cause clear while preserving other FCR31 bits
SQRT.S signed-zero/negative finite behavior and I/D cause handling for supported finite operands
